name: Kao no nai Tsuki -Matsuyoi no Soutsubaki-
original_name: 顔のない月-待宵の双椿-
source:
Summer, 2000.

In Kusaka Village, a secluded settlement deep in the mountains of Shinshu, preparations for a festival were quietly underway.
It was a secret rite, held only once every nineteen years, called The Moon-Waiting Ceremony.

The ceremony was presided over by the Kuraki family, who have dominated this land since ancient times. They lived in a magnificent Western-style mansion overgrown with blooming flowers, known as the Camellia Mansion, a mysterious clan that adhered to its own unique customs.

The protagonist, Hayama Kouichi, is summoned by the head family, the Kuraki clan, and sets out for the Camellia Mansion. He suffers from a strange illness that prevents him from recognizing women's faces, is tormented by daily nightmares, and on that day, he arrived as if he had been carried in, having been seized by hallucinations.

However, when he wakes up from his nightmare at the Kuraki residence, he suddenly becomes able to see women's faces clearly. The person he sees is Kuraki Suzuna. This house's only daughter and the Moon-Waiting Priestess.

Kouichi is eventually told that he will become the head of the Kuraki family and is ordered to stay in the mansion until The Moon-Waiting Ceremony one month later—

[b]What will blossom at the end of the secret rite held in this mysterious village—
translation:
2000年夏天。

在信州深山僻静的草坂村，祭典的准备工作正在悄然进行。
这是一个秘密仪式，每十九年举行一次，名为“待月大典”。

仪式由自古统治这片土地的仓木家族主持。他们居住在一座繁花似锦、富丽堂皇的西式宅邸，名为“茶花府”，是一个恪守着自己独特习俗的神秘家族。

主人公叶山浩一受到当家仓木家的召唤，前往山茶花馆。他患有一种奇怪的疾病，使他无法辨认女性的面孔，每天都被噩梦所折磨，那天，他就像是被人抬进来的，被幻觉抓住了。

然而，当他从仓木家的噩梦中醒来时，他突然能够看清女人的脸。他看到的人是仓木铃奈。这个家的独生女，也是望月神女。

浩一最终被告知，他将成为仓木家的家主，并被命令留在宅邸，直到一个月后的待月仪式——

[b]在这个神秘村庄举行的秘密仪式结束时，将会绽放出什么——
